profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary: Experienced software engineering lead with a history of working on security/privacy and high availability distributed web-applications. Skilled in Java, Golang, Kubernetes, and architecture.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: High performance networking for Google Compute Engine

positions.title: Principal Member of the Technical Staff
positions.description:
○ Designed & prototyped a deployment system for OCI teams to automate installation, upgrade, and rollbacks of cloud services. (React, Java, Go, Protobuf, Temporal)
○ Created a Protobuf based DSL and execution engine to automate runbooks based on metrics.
○ Built a system to convert Docker containers into Firecracker VMs.
○ Led a team of five to launch a data sovereignty assurance gateway for data warehouse tables (Parquet, ORC, CSV) supporting 2 Tbps of traffic.

positions.title: Senior Security Software Engineer II
positions.description:
Worked in the privacy organization automating data subject rights and improving technical foundations.

○ Rebuilt Cruise’s DSR service (Python) to to resolve data quality issues allowing legal to self-service assurance audits.
○ Designed and built an API gateway between a privacy vendor (Transcend) and Cruise’s 1P systems mapping their JWT/GraphQL based system into REST and Cruise’s in-house Envoy+OPA auth system.
○ Improved the team’s set of microservices by setting up monitoring, alerting, Terraform, CI, and fixing security issues.
positions.insights: Skills: Python · Kubernetes · Digital Authentication · Privacy Compliance · General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR)

positions.title: Software Engineering Manager
positions.description:
Led a team of six to own two GA products (Cloud Run for Anthos and Kf) while delivering a new, production service.

○  Led planning and development of an internal service enabling end-user programmability in other Google products to support 18 partner teams.
○ Improved team morale by defining a clear scope, product roadmaps, and creating a psychologically safe team
atmosphere leading to all team metrics being +9-16pp vs Google.
○ Stabilized our legacy products by setting up a robust on-call, playbooks, and release qualification pipeline.
○ Worked with a key customer to scope and deliver features driving an additional $5M in annual recurring revenue.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Led security and privacy hardening across engineering teams prior to Squarespace acquisition.

○ Audited and mitigated security & privacy risk in the product’s code, cloud infrastructure, config, and manual processes.
○ Established a cross-team working group to give insight into progress and prevent backsliding.
○ Designed, implemented, and launched DNSSEC DNSKEY support in the product as a market differentiator.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Founding member and tech lead for a team building a Cloud Foundry compatible PaaS on Kubernetes.

○ Co-authored the original design, conducted user research, and pitched the technology at Cloud Foundry Summit 2019.
○ Created a wide variety of component designs to achieve Cloud Foundry functionality natively in Kubernetes.
○ Built Kubernetes controllers and a CLI in Go to orchestrate K8s, Istio, Tekton CI, and Buildpacks.
○ Wrote technical documentation and how-to guides published on cloud.google.com.

positions.title: Sr. Software Developer
positions.description:
* Mentored a team of five new developers to re-build a legacy system in Spring Boot and Vue.js
* Created roadmap and made architectural decisions to transition us from a COBOL system written in '69 to a modern microservice architecture

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
* Built a rules engine and rules management system to automate commission management
* Built and deployed Spring (Java) reporting applications
* Wrote a domain specific language (DSL) so business can create self-serve reports
* Created roadmap and made architectural decisions to transition us from a COBOL system written in '69 to a modern microservice architecture

positions.title: Graduate Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
* Designed new course materials and projects
* Taught a lab section of 24 students
* Received an "excellent" (top) rating from 100% of the students I taught
* Designed and implemented test cases for automated grading and feedback

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description:
* Built a realtime embedded realtime autipilot for UAVs in C++.
* Added components to a QT desktop application.
* Created a time-series database to store 1 million points of sensor data per day in MySQL
* Built a web front-end for this database in Python with django
* Created a Java desktop application to analyze the sensor data
